patch_description: Add a ruin-and-recreate perturbation phase between the greedy restarts and the local search. After greedy construction produces a good base sequence, iteratively remove 3-8 random transactions, then greedily reinsert each removed transaction (in random order) at its best position evaluated with the true makespan cost. Accept only improvements and repeat until the time budget expires, keeping the best solution found. This combines the proven gain of ruin-and-recreate (23 makespan units at identical construction settings per Gen 20) with the existing descent, and effectively acts as a large-neighborhood search that escapes local optima that plain relocation/swap moves cannot.
